name: Beatriz Almeida Santos
headline: Junior UX/Product Designer
summary: Junior UX/Product Designer with 2 years of experience creating user-centered digital products. Skilled in wireframing, prototyping, and conducting usability tests to inform design decisions. Passionate about collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive interfaces.

responsibilities: Assisted in creating wireframes and low-fidelity prototypes for mobile applications
Conducted user interviews and synthesized findings into actionable insights
Collaborated with developers to ensure design feasibility
Supported the design team in maintaining the company's design system
Designed high-fidelity prototypes for web and mobile products using Figma
Conducted usability testing sessions and iterated designs based on feedback
Worked closely with product managers to translate requirements into user flows
Created and maintained design documentation for handoff to engineering
